Definition: Rekem, the name of a place in Palestine, also of a Midianite and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Rekem = "variegation"; n pr m 1) one of the 5 kings of Midian killed by the Israelites; 2) one of the 4 sons of Hebron and the father of Shammai; 3) a Manassite, son of Machir by Maachah his wife; n pr loc; 4) a town in Benjamin; site unknown
